summary: White paint on steel, flaked off in sharp chips where the coat has failed, showing the bare metal underneath.
_comment: Paint on metal, chipped: a white semi-gloss enamel on steel (railings, machinery, lockers, tool cabinets) that has flaked off in small sharp-edged chips to show bare steel. TWOLAYER (MasterSet: two real opaque layers, the mask choosing where layer 2 sits): layer 1 is the paint (param-only: ambientCG's painted-steel scans Metal027-029 declare metalness 1 everywhere, which is not paint), layer 2 the bare steel substrate (the library's existing Metal002 scan, the MildSteel_Raw set's _s01 maps, reused rather than imported twice), placed by the PaintChip02 mask (R = where the coat has chipped off). Re-made at its tag (2026-10-31, Phase19 D-9): the tile was 0.3 m, the steel scan's judged size, off its s01 tag; the steel maps are now quilted from that scan into an exact 0.1 m tile (tools/converters/base/quilt_scan.py), every patch at the scan's own size, written at 512 px. Nothing stretched. The chips are sampled at the mask's own 1 m size (2-12 mm flakes, gathered in clusters where the coat failed, with long intact stretches between). Re-masked 2026-11-01 for the maintainer's redo, "this pattern is also super repetitive": PaintChip01 held one layout of chips in 10 cm, so every face repeated it as a grid. maskset_blend MUST be non-zero (it defaults to 1 here) or the steel never shows. The Creator tint is a whole-material control (the blend happens before it), so it tints the bare steel as well as the paint. Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): scratches (overlay 1, damage, gated by PaintChip02's G, the cracked halo round each chip) and dust as a deposit (overlay 2, gated by its B, settled in the chips); overlay 3 is empty, as the row has it. Built by the Phase11 batch.
name: Paint_OnMetal_Chipped_Base_s01_v01

sources.note: Layer 1, the paint: a whiteboard is a white enamel on steel, so its colour and IOR are taken; its roughness 0 is not (a semi-gloss enamel, see the judgement).
Layer 2, the bare steel: the MildSteel_Raw set's _s01 maps, reused.

sources.why: re-makes layer 2's steel at the scale option: quilted at the scan's own size, never stretched (resampled to 1152 px first, a resolution change, so 0.1 m is a whole number of patch steps)
roughness_const 0.35 for a semi-gloss industrial enamel; meters_per_tile 0.1, the s01 scale option's length; maskset_blend 1 so the chips show the steel fully at the defaults.
